test_title: PYST 63: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On : 07 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Samir purchased 20 dozens of toys at the rate of Rs. 372 per dozen. He sold each one of them at the rate of Rs. 32. What was his percentage profit?
solution:
Total cost price = 20 × 372 = Rs. 7440

Total selling price = 20 × 12 × 32 = Rs. 7680

Profit = Selling price - Cost price = 7680 - 7440 = Rs. 240

Profit percentage = (Profit/Cost price) × 100

⇒ Profit percentage = (240/7440) × 100 = 3.22%

**Therefore, the percentage profit was 3.22%.**
